args.message:
Fix FIN-212: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) in round_money

The docstring specified banker's rounding per FIN-212, but the
implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP. This caused tests/test_money.py
to fail in the nightly build (e.g. 2.665 should round to 2.66, not 2.67,
and 2.675 to 2.68). Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN to match the spec.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix FIN-212: use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was implemented with `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: import and apply `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP` in `round_money`, matching the documented behavior (docstring already specified banker's rounding per FIN-212).

## Examples
- `2.675` → `2.68` (both modes agree)
- `2.665` → `2.66` (banker's rounding: rounds to even; old code gave `2.67`)

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.
